action_items: OPTIONAL (carry-over from iter38/39): showcase produce runs synchronously in the HTTP thread; a 40-90s ffmpeg concat blocks the request. Consider background job + SSE/progress-poll so the founder can see each stage tick in real time.

OPTIONAL: /app/backend/rendered_assets/media_masters accumulates one job dir per produce/produce-proof call — add a retention policy (e.g., keep last 10 or referenced by media_assets/production_acceptance_records).
critical_code_review_comments: flagship_showcase.produce_flagship() logs 'draft_preview' step for auto_select_draft AFTER master_asset_vault registration but does NOT emit a step at line ~289 when dist_ready is False and is_draft is False — the else branch emits 'distribution_hold' correctly. No action, just note. This branch matched only when human-approval scenes come through with QA<100 (untested this iteration).

flagship_showcase.certify_gold_master()'s tech and brand gates require score>=100. A human-approved run with 92-98 will silently fail all-gates and return unmet_gates without hinting scores. Consider surfacing tech_score/brand_score inside the response for the failure path so the founder sees WHY it was blocked without opening the record.

FlagshipShowcase.js: after clicking Approve, the button DOM re-renders (button className flips based on rejected disabled state) which caused a stale-DOM click race in one Playwright pass (harmless — approval still went through). Consider using an unchanging container element (e.g., data-testid on the outer div) for Playwright, or keying the Approve button by scene id AND state so it isn't unmounted.

FlagshipShowcase.js runMatch() resets ALL scene state on every 'Search again' click (preserves only locked scenes) — clicking 'Search again' inside Scene 2 restarts the full match for every scene, not just Scene 2. Intended? If the intent is per-scene re-search, add a per-scene endpoint or narrow the state reset to the touched scene.
FlagshipShowcase.js Replace button just shows a toast 'Pick a different candidate above to replace the selection.' — no keyboard focus jump into the carousel. Minor UX polish.

flagship_showcase.certify_gold_master() only permits certify on qru_asset_id, not the acceptance record_id. If the founder holds only a record id (e.g., from /showcase/records), a second lookup is needed. Consider also accepting {record_id} for symmetry.
